Gaston Boissier's _Promenades archéologiques : Rome et Pompéi_ (1880). The English title here identifies the French work.

The cover is Hachette BnF's 2016 facsimile of the 1880 edition, ISBN 9782011953261. [Edition details](https://www.hachettebnf.fr/livre/promenades-archeologiques-rome-et-pompei-9782011953261/).
